//: Vendored SecScan engine unit. The .ts files beside this config are byte-frozen (AS-IS-MANIFEST.json) and were written for the SecScan service's bundler-based build, so this config mirrors that codebase's compiler settings instead of the runner's NodeNext/strict ones: moduleResolution Bundler (the sources use extensionless relative imports; scripts/secscan-dist.mjs rewrites the emitted specifiers to .js for Node), and the service's selective strictness rather than full strict. The three bare imports the engine makes (pino, @workspace/db, drizzle-orm) resolve through paths to the embedded shims in ../../secscan-shims (types) and ../../secscan-vendor (runtime, copied into dist/secscan/node_modules by the build).
